data.name: Mehraban
data.gender_notes: Mehraban is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehraban is a Persian name that signifies a person who is kind, loving, and compassionate. It is a popular name in Islamic culture, reflecting the importance of empathy and benevolence. The name Mehraban carries the meaning “Kind and loving” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehraban usually hope their child will grow to embody kind and loving and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Mehraban is reminiscent of the Quranic concept of 'rahma' or mercy, which is a fundamental aspect of Islamic spirituality.
data.etymology: Mehraban belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kind and loving.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehraban total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مهرابان
in_arabic.meaning: الشخص الذي يتصف بالرحمة و الإحسان
in_arabic.long_meaning: مهرابان هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'م-ه-ر-ب' والذي يحمل معاني الرحمة و الإحسان. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة و الأخلاق الرفيعة في الإسلام. الشخص الذي يحمل هذا الاسم يتصف بالتعاطف و الرأفة مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: مہرابان
in_urdu.meaning: رحم دل اور احسان کرنے والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہرابان ایک عربی मूल کا نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رحم دل اور احسان کرنے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں اچھے اخلاق اور رحمت کی صفات کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس نام کا استعمال ایک قابل تعریف شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मेहराबान
in_hindi.meaning: दयालु और अच्छा व्यवहार करने वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मेहराबान एक नाम है जो अरबी मूल से निकला है और जिसका अर्थ है दयालु और अच्छा व्यवहार करने वाला। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में अच्छे गुणों और नैतिकता को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग एक सम्मानजनक व्यक्तित्व की ओर संकेत करता है।

in_pashto.name: مهربان
in_pashto.meaning: د پښتو ژبی د مهرباني اوښيار شخص
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهربان د پښتو ژبی یو نوم دی چی د مهرباني اوښيار شخص مطلب لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودو کی د يو مثبت ځانګړتیا ګڼل کيږي. دا نوم د رحمت او نيکۍ صفاتو څرګندونه کوي.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mehraban holds significant cultural significance in Persian and Islamic traditions. In Persian literature, the name is often associated with generosity, kindness, and hospitality. Mehraban is a reminder of the value of treating others with love and warmth, which resonates with Islamic teachings of respecting all of God's creation and striving towards social harmony and peace.
data.spiritual_significance: Mehraban is also a name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture. It is a reminder of the Prophet Muhammad's (peace be upon him) famous hadith, "The best of you is the one who is best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family." (Sahih Muslim 2521). The name Mehraban serves as a constant reminder to be kind, loving, and compassionate towards our families and loved ones, reflecting the teachings of Islam that emphasize the importance of maintaining strong family bonds and demonstrating love and kindness to those around us.
